name: Red Hot Chili Peppers

whyMatters.en: LA funk-rock four-piece; Blood Sugar Sex Magik (1991) and Californication (1999) made Flea's slap bass and Frusciante's clean-to-crunch guitar the alternative-radio default.
whyMatters.zh: 洛杉矶 funk-rock 四人组；Blood Sugar Sex Magik（1991）与 Californication（1999）让 Flea 打点贝斯与 Frusciante 干净到 crunch 的吉他成为 alternative 电台默认。

lyricQuotes: Under the bridge downtown / Is where I drew some blood
Give it away, give it away, give it away now

shortBio.en: Kiedis / Flea / Frusciante funk-alt; Blood Sugar and Californication are the radio peaks.
shortBio.zh: Kiedis / Flea / Frusciante 的 funk-alt；Blood Sugar 与 Californication 是电台高峰。

body.en:
Formed 1983 in LA. Mother's Milk and Blood Sugar Sex Magik (Rick Rubin) lock the hard-funk template: Flea's slap bass as lead voice, Frusciante's chord voicings, Chad Smith's pocket.

Californication (1999) and By the Way add melodic ballad craft after lineup churn. The citation tracks—Give It Away, Under the Bridge, Californication—show how funk rhythm and hard-rock distortion share one four-piece without rap-metal's later polish.
body.zh:
1983 年于 LA 组建。Mother's Milk 与 Blood Sugar Sex Magik（Rick Rubin）锁定硬 funk 模板：Flea 打点贝斯作主声部、Frusciante 和弦声部、Chad Smith 口袋感。

Californication（1999）与 By the Way 在阵容动荡后加入旋律谣曲工艺。引用曲——Give It Away、Under the Bridge、Californication——说明 funk 节奏与 hard-rock 失真如何共用四人组，且无后期 rap-metal 抛光。

note.en: Rubin-produced funk-punk peak; Flea slap bass as lead hook on MTV.
note.zh: Rubin 制作的 funk-punk 高峰；Flea 打点贝斯当主 hook 上 MTV。

note.en: Clean arpeggios and falsetto chorus; ballad side enters rock radio.
note.zh: 干净琶音与假声副歌；谣曲面进入摇滚电台。

note.en: Frusciante return cycle; melodic riff over dry Rick Rubin mix.
note.zh: Frusciante 回归周期；干声 Rubin 混音上的旋律 riff。

title.zh: Funk 贝斯遇上 alt-rock 电台

body.en:
Blood Sugar Sex Magik (1991) puts slap bass and punk-funk rhythm on MTV beside grunge. Rick Rubin's dry mix keeps drums forward; Frusciante's clean-to-crunch toggles define the guitar chair.

Californication (1999) proves the same four can carry ballad singles without losing the pocket. RHCP sit on the 1990s map as LA's funk-hard answer to Seattle quiet-loud.
body.zh:
Blood Sugar Sex Magik（1991）把打点贝斯与 punk-funk 节奏送上 MTV，与 grunge 并列。Rick Rubin 干混让鼓靠前；Frusciante 干净到 crunch 的切换定义吉他席。

Californication（1999）证明同一四人组也能扛谣曲单曲而不丢口袋感。RHCP 在 1990 年代地图上，是 LA 对西雅图强弱动态的 funk-hard 回答。

title.en: Frusciante cycles vs one constant rhythm section
title.zh: Frusciante 周期 vs 固定 rhythm section

body.en:
Kiedis and Flea are the spine from 1983. Frusciante enters 1988, exits after Blood Sugar, returns for Californication through By the Way. Chad Smith's drums stay from 1988.

Peak citation is the Rubin/Frusciante/Smith quartet. Navarro and later guitarists mark side chapters; catalog memory stays on the Frusciante funk-alt silhouette.
body.zh:
Kiedis 与 Flea 自 1983 起是脊柱。Frusciante 1988 入队、Blood Sugar 后离队、Californication 至 By the Way 回归。Chad Smith 自 1988 起守鼓席。

引用峰值是 Rubin/Frusciante/Smith 四人组。Navarro 与后期吉他手是旁支；目录记忆停在 Frusciante funk-alt 剪影。

title.en: Funk pocket in 2000s alt and stadium rock
title.zh: 2000 年代 alt 与体育场的 funk 口袋

body.en:
Foo Fighters and Muse cite the melodic hard-rock side; funk bass as lead instrument travels into 2000s festival sets. Less grunge DNA than Seattle peers—more LA punk-funk and Van Halen chord moves.

Influence is measurable in slap-bass-forward rock radio and in bands that copy Flea's register without the Kiedis rap-flow.
body.zh:
Foo Fighters 与 Muse 引用旋律 hard-rock 面；主奏级 funk 贝斯进入 2000 年代音乐节。grunge DNA 少于西雅图同辈——更偏 LA punk-funk 与 Van Halen 式和弦。

影响可在打点贝斯靠前的摇滚电台，以及只抄 Flea 音区、难抄 Kiedis rap-flow 的乐队中度量。
